heading: Termination of Overseas Private Investment Corporation and other superceded authorities
lead: Effective at the end of the transition period—

tree.text: the Overseas Private Investment Corporation is terminated; and

notes.text: Codification Section is comprised of section 1464 of Pub. L. 115–254. Par. (2) of section 1464 of Pub. L. 115–254 repealed title IV of chapter 2 of part I of the Foreign Assistance Act of 1961 (22 U.S.C. 2191 et seq.), other than subsections (g), (l), (m), and (n) of section 237 thereof (22 U.S.C. 2197(g), (l), (m), (n)).
